intro.text: A siege of Kholinar, the Alethi capital, by a large singer army that massed outside the city, seized the villages around it and enslaved their people while the Alethi army was away on the Shattered Plains.
A siege of Kholinar by singers and Fused. A small team under King Elhokar slipped in to open the city's Oathgate, but the city fell, Elhokar was killed and several of the team ended up in Shadesmar.

items.text: With Kholinar in turmoil, Elhokar wanted to win back his capital. Dalinar agreed to send him there with Kaladin to unlock the city's Oathgate, so that soldiers from Urithiru could cross.

With most Alethi soldiers away on the Shattered Plains, the singers massed a large army outside Kholinar almost unopposed, taking over the villages nearby and enslaving their people while it waited for more of its forces.
The Fused drove humans too weak for farm work into the city to crowd it, and made captives build ladders to climb its walls.
Elhokar's team flew to the city: Kaladin, his bridgemen Skar and Drehy, Adolin, Shallan and her spies Ishnah, Vathah and Red.

The team camped near the city and walked in disguised among refugees, whom the besiegers let through to use up the city's food. Soldiers under Highmarshal Azure let only a set number in each day, and a Fused raid probed the defences as the team arrived.

The besiegers kept wearing the city down. Spren called screamers sensed any fabrial in use, spanreeds included, and called Fused to deal with it, which cut Kholinar off from its allies. Fused also raided the walls to test them, while the Kholinar Wall Guard under Azure held the defences.
The team took shelter in the home of Adolin's tailor. When Shallan tried to take a message to the queen, a palace guard stabbed her; she played dead and got away.

The team then split up. Elhokar, with Adolin as his bodyguard, met the city's remaining lighteyed nobles to win their support. Shallan and her spies stole food and handed it to the poor, earning her the name Swiftspren, as a way into the Cult of Moments, fanatics who held the Oathgate platform.
Kaladin joined the Wall Guard to learn about it and how it fed the city, and found that its leader, Azure, was a woman.

Shallan found out that a gang had been seizing the food she gave away, and one of the people she had fed died. She fell into despair until Wit helped her through it by sharing the tale of The Girl Who Looked Up.
When Fused attacked the wall, Kaladin helped defend it and killed one of them. He then showed Azure his Shardblade and told her the king had sent him to save the city.

Azure showed him how the Wall Guard fed Kholinar: two Soulcasters worked in a hidden room, kept from the screamers by metal sheets a man had brought. Kaladin told her of the plan to bring the Alethi army through the Oathgate, and won the Wall Guard over to storming the palace with the team.

The attack on the palace began to drums, and the besiegers launched their own full assault to keep reinforcements from coming through the Oathgate. A thunderclast scaled the city wall, Shallan and the Windrunners took on the Fused, and Azure and Adolin led their soldiers into the palace, cutting through its doors with Shardblades.
In the royal chambers Kaladin found Elhokar's son Gavinor under attack from strange red spren. Queen Aesudan, her eyes glowing red, boasted of bonding ancient spren and set her soldiers on them.

At the Oathgate, Shallan's Shardblade could not harm the Unmade there, but she withstood it until it drew back. In the control room a figure in a mirror, Sja-anat, warned her that the gate had been made into a trap.
Seeing his Wall Guard friends and parshmen he knew killing each other, Kaladin lost the will to fight. Elhokar, carrying Gavinor, began to speak Radiant Words, but Moash ran him through with a spear.

With huge numbers of parshmen filling the streets and Fused overhead, Adolin judged the city lost and ordered an escape to Urithiru. Despite the warning, Shallan activated the whole Oathgate platform.
In Urithiru, Dalinar's troops waited on the Oathgate for hours until word came by spanreed that Kholinar had fallen.
The Oathgate sent Adolin, Shallan, Kaladin and Azure into Shadesmar rather than Urithiru. Elhokar was dead, and Adolin realized that he was now king.
The singers took and held the city.
Skar and Drehy, left behind in Kholinar, escaped with a few survivors and with Gavinor, Elhokar's heir.
